about: Source to frontend diagnostic cases; the backend never runs. A case with a code expects the first diagnostic to have that code at line/column (1-based; columns count Unicode scalar values) and a message containing `message`. A null code means the frontend accepts the source. `input` is `flat` (one file) or `package` (the root module of a minimal package).
